"use client";

import {Button} from "@heroui/react";

export default function App() {
  return (
    <Button
      isLoading
      color="secondary"
      spinner={
        <svg
          className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-current"
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        >
          <circle
            className="opacity-25"
            cx="12"
            cy="12"
            r="10"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="4"
          />
          <path
            className="opacity-75"
            d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"
            fill="currentColor"
          />
        </svg>
      }
    >
      Loading
    </Button>
  );
}

documentation:
# HeroUI Button

15 published HeroUI button examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples for HeroUI 2.8.10; these APIs do not target HeroUI 3.
- Mount HeroUIProvider at your client root. Configure the HeroUI Tailwind plugin and scan node_modules/@heroui/theme/dist/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}. Keep the matching Framer Motion dependency.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.

Upstream: https://www.heroui.com/docs/components/button
Pinned source: https://github.com/heroui-inc/heroui/blob/46e1f1f78e7777bc8639399e4f5fd913de046d33/apps/docs/content/components/button/usage.raw.jsx
